requested_count: as many spectacular African works as possible
scope: Continuation of the African art acquisition: the institutional Sketchfab leads saved in docs/ingest/african-art-20261002-leads.json, fetched with the Sketchfab download API on GitHub Actions runners, optimized (Draco geometry, WebP textures) and published to the atrium-models R2 bucket at models.atrium.earth. Every thumbnail and source record was reviewed; non-African objects, scans with baked-in scale bars, AI-generated reconstructions, unidentified fragments, vessels, souvenirs and duplicate scans were withheld.
newest_behavior: Newest Additions shows the whole latest batch when it exceeds 24 works; the catalog order leads with the batch highlights.
